hf:tencent/OmniEVIE-4B.description: *OmniEVIE-4B** is a 4.5B-parameter unified multi-modal, multi-vector retrieval model by **Tencent IMA Product Center** and **Tencent Youtu Lab**. Built on Qwen3.5 with bidirectional full-attention layers, Prefix-MRL projection, spatio-temporal Ward clustering (**ST-HAC**), and a learned query saliency gate (`query_gate.safetensors`), it distills every document into at most `128 × 64D int8` vectors (**≤ 9,472 bytes/record**, **8.82 GiB per 1M records**)—retrieving across a million records in **54.2 ms** on one CPU thread while tracing every hit straight back to its page region or video second.
